title: King's State Department code: the paragraph on Sweden, No. 29, 13 April 1797
caption: The opening of the coded paragraph on Sweden, lines 7-13 of King's No. 29 (NARA RG 59, M30 roll 4, frame 0092, right page), with his clear words between the code. King's codebook has not been found, and no decipherment of this despatch was found, so every group here is read from a rebuilt key. The codebook was rebuilt from King's other despatches: on 48 coded copies of them a State Department clerk wrote the plain word over each coded word, and those words, collected group by group, give the values; the rebuilt key was then tested once, on a despatch it had never seen, against the Department's clear copy (0.946 agreement). The full account is under "The key for this passage". The code builds long words from syllables, so words are spelt as the code spells them (par-ti-all-i-ty, nation-all, oppose-ite). Amber groups have no value from any other despatch and rest on this letter's context alone (717 dul, 389 lect, 1279 major, 1074 ock, 1490 hol).
key_note: How the codebook was rebuilt. King's codebook (about 1,600 numbered words and syllables; 769 = the) has not been found. But when his coded despatches reached the State Department, its clerks wrote the plain word over each coded word on 48 of the 57 coded copies on the film. Those 72 frames were transcribed group by group without any key in view (13,603 groups), and each group took the word the clerks wrote over it, by majority where they differ. Groups that only ever appear inside longer words were solved by requiring every such word to split into syllables of the code's printed word list, one per group. Before any of it was used, the key was frozen and tested once, as declared in advance, on a despatch it had never seen (No. 59): it agreed with the Department's clear copy at 0.946 of the groups it covers. It also agrees with King's letters as printed in his Life and Correspondence (No. 30: 201 of 227 groups). The result, key.tsv, has values for 764 of the code's groups; key_method.md gives the sources, grades and checks.
